summary: This code runs once when the page first loads and prints a friendly message to the browser's developer console using styled text. It's a fun Easter egg that greets curious developers who open DevTools.

explanations.5: useEffect with an empty dependency array [] means this code runs exactly once after the component first renders, not on every re-render.
explanations.7: The '%c' is a special format code that tells console.log to apply CSS styling to the text that follows. The \u{1F9AB} is a unicode meerkat emoji.
explanations.8: This string is CSS that gets applied to the previous console.log line, making the text large, bold, and orange.
